descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
We are seeking for an experienced Data Engineer to join our team. 
 Role requirements: 
5+ years of experience in the implementation and tuning of Data Lake/Hadoop Spark platforms, BI, and ETL
Strong experience in the design and implementation of several of the following: Master & Reference Data Management, Metadata Management, Data Quality Management, Data Analytics and BI, Data Modelling, Data Exchanges
Hands-on experience leading large-scale global data warehousing and analytics projects
Experience in defining, implementing, and scaling Data Modelling or API Design practices
Experience delivering data platforms in Azure Cloud
Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
English - Fluent in speaking and writing.
 Technical competences: 
Spark (preferably on Databricks)
Strong experience in Python
Experience working with data in various formats (np. Avro, Parquet, JSON, CSV)
Experience in designing and building APIs + API management is a plus
Data Modelling
Kubernetes / Docker
Git + CI/CD (preferably on Azure DevOps)
Cloud computing practices: Infra as Code, security (preferably on Azure).
 As a Data Engineer, you will have to: 
Industrialize our ingestion patterns on our Azure Cloud / Databricks solution, using state-of-the art technologies (Spark, Docker, Azure Pipelines, Python)
Help with the onboarding of new product squads directly on the new cloud Data Platform or participate in those
Monitor and enhance the performance and utilization of clusters and FinOps, ensuring efficient resource management and cost optimization
Design, build, and maintain common patterns such as CI/CD Pipelines, shared libraries (data pipeline development, data quality, data lineage), and shared services (API’s, data viz, monitoring, scheduler)
Support a community of data engineers and data scientists by understanding their problems and answering their questions, and help them write the solutions on the Data Platform
Participate in the data onboarding of third-party data providers such as Bloomberg or internal applications.
 Hybrid work with 3 days in the office in either Bucharest/Timisoara/Cluj/Brasov 
 Why should you join us? 
We have a solid company (projects that last minimum one year), and employees stay with us on average for about 10 years
We have many projects (50+) and lots of career opportunities. After you finish your first project, for the next one you can choose to master the skills that you already know, or learn new technologies on the next one. This way, you do not have to change the company, just the project
Reimbursement of agreed certifications
Private medical subscription
Team buildings.
